plugins.name: Safebooru
plugins.description: Safe-for-work images; no account needed. Comes with Vitrine (install it here to bring it back after removing it).

plugins.name: Realbooru
plugins.description: Read through the site's web pages (its API is switched off). No account needed.

changes: An optional account: log in to download your favorites (fav:me).

plugins.name: Rule 34
plugins.description: Needs a free account: API key and user ID (Settings > Sites after installing).

changes: Downloads up to 6 files at once when a search has many (needs Vitrine 1.0.6).
Files are downloaded from the exact address the site links to: the plain address sometimes gave broken copies.

plugins.name: Rule34Hentai
plugins.description: Shimmie2, read through the site's web pages. An account is optional (sign in with your user name and password).

plugins.name: baraag.net
plugins.description: Mastodon server for art: #hashtags (#art #furry, ~#either, -#without) and @profiles. Files and hashtags, the author as the creator. An access token is optional.

plugins.name: Danbooru
plugins.description: Anime-style art. An account is optional (more tags per search, every file, your favorites with fav:me).

changes: Downloads up to 6 files at once when a search has many (needs Vitrine 1.0.6).

plugins.name: Safebooru (Danbooru)
plugins.description: Danbooru's safe-for-work mirror. No account needed.

changes: Downloads up to 6 files at once when a search has many (needs Vitrine 1.0.6).

plugins.name: E-Hentai Galleries
plugins.description: Galleries (doujinshi, manga, image sets) as comics on the Comics page. An account is optional.

changes: Reads the site's pages at one a second again, which the site handles better.

plugins.name: ExHentai
plugins.description: Like E-Hentai, on exhentai.org: needs an e-hentai account with ExHentai access.

changes: Reads the site's pages one every 3 seconds: at one a second the site banned the address for a while.
Reads the site's pages at one a second again, which the site handles better.

plugins.name: yande.re
plugins.description: High-resolution anime-style scans and art (Moebooru). No account needed; fav:<name> for someone's favorites.

plugins.name: Konachan
plugins.description: Anime-style wallpapers (Moebooru). No account needed. Some countries are sent to konachan.net: use Konachan (safe) there.

plugins.name: Konachan (safe)
plugins.description: Konachan's safe-for-work side: only posts rated safe. No account needed.

plugins.name: Sakugabooru
plugins.description: Clips of notable animation, mostly short videos (Moebooru). No account needed.

plugins.name: e621
plugins.description: Furry art, animation and video. An account is optional: user name + API key (some files are hidden without one; fav:me).

plugins.name: e926
plugins.description: e621's safe-for-work side: only posts rated safe. An account is optional (user name + API key).

plugins.name: RedGIFs
plugins.description: Short adult videos and pictures: tags, @user (the creator), or a clip's link. No account needed.

plugins.name: Rule34 (paheal)
plugins.description: A large rule 34 site with many animated posts (Shimmie2, through its API). Tags are mostly names: characters, series, artists. No account needed.

plugins.name: Gelbooru
plugins.description: Anime art (Gelbooru), with artist, character and series tags. Needs a free account.

plugins.name: Xbooru
plugins.description: Adult art (Gelbooru), with artist, character and series tags. No account needed.

plugins.name: HypnoHub
plugins.description: Hypnosis-themed art, much of it adult (Gelbooru). No account needed.

plugins.name: AIBooru
plugins.description: AI-generated pictures (Danbooru), with the model used as a tag. An account is optional (user name + API key).

plugins.name: Pawoo
plugins.description: Mastodon server for art, much of it Japanese: #hashtags and @profiles. Files and hashtags, the author as the creator. An access token is optional.
